exposure: rank (as a proxy for socioeconomic status)
cohort: Active-duty service women (ADSW) aged 17-49 with births during fiscal years 2016-2023 within the US Military Health System.
finding: Minoritized racial groups and lower-rank active-duty service women experienced disparities in perinatal outcomes within the Military Health System.
mod_finding: Black, Asian and Pacific Islander, and American Indian/Alaska Native women showed higher risk of induction of labor and cesarean section, while officers had a higher risk for cesarean births.
